title: test: add concurrent-session test for flash keystore
description: No test exercises two sessions on the same flash token simultaneously. This matters because keystore read/write and session state are not obviously synchronized. Add a test: open two sessions on the same flash token, perform C_Sign from both concurrently (or at least interleaved), verify both signatures with independent oracles. The goal is to expose race conditions in keystore file I/O or session state shared between handles. Without this, concurrent-use bugs would only surface in production.
